_template_notes: Replace all TEMPLATE values and evidence references.
Keep nominal interface geometry separate from printer/process compensation.
The 16 placement_transform values are a row-major source-to-project matrix.
Add exact keep-out meshes or swept volumes in the CAD project; AABBs are planning proxies.
A structurally valid plan may still be blocked from later gates; record that distinction in decision_log.

project.title: Template hybrid printable product

coordinate_frame.origin: center of primary mounting datum at lowest product plane
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps component source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: The parametric core shall carry all primary service loads without relying on generated ornament.
requirements.verification: load-path review and physical prototype test

requirements.statement: The front ornament shall preserve the approved hero-view silhouette and remain replaceable.
requirements.source: concept image IMG-001 and design brief
requirements.verification: matched clay renders and assembly test

requirements.statement: No printed component may enter the functional keep-out volume.
requirements.verification: exact CAD collision test and slicer review

global_style.summary: TEMPLATE_STYLE: coherent medium-scale organic relief over a restrained functional core
global_style.generation_material: matte neutral clay with broad diffuse lighting
global_style.detail_hierarchy: primary silhouette first, secondary forms second, sparse printable relief last

assembly_sequence: Install purchased mounting hardware into CORE.
Attach BACKER to CORE or manufacture it as part of CORE.
Insert ORNAMENT into the keyed BACKER after fit coupon approval.
Verify access, keep-outs, and removal without damaging CORE.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the printer, material, orientation, and profile used for interface compensation.
decision_log.current_basis: Template FDM process values are planning assumptions only.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Named production profile and process-matched fit coupon results.

decision_log.topic: Approve the immutable concept image, component mask, and view set for ORNAMENT.
decision_log.current_basis: IMG-001 and related references are placeholders.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Attached source image, evidence crop, mask, and approved generation plates.

components.name: Primary parametric core
components.role: structural, functional, mounting, and datum authority

manufacturing.orientation: defined by structural layer direction and bed fit

components.name: Parametric ornament backer
components.role: exact seat, key, anti-rotation, and load-spreading transition

manufacturing.method: FDM or fused with CORE before export
manufacturing.orientation: inherit CORE unless printed as separate coupon

manufacturing.method: FDM as a separate replaceable body
manufacturing.material: silk PLA or compatible decorative filament after fit testing
manufacturing.orientation: choose for visible surface and root strength; validate support access

image_to_3d.positive_prompt: One coherent sculptural ornament with a strong readable silhouette, medium-scale flowing forms, sparse printable relief, matte neutral clay, and a thick quiet rear root for later trimming.
negative_spaces: central opening shall remain open and connected

components.name: Purchased mounting hardware
components.role: standard fastener and installation tool envelope
functions: transfer product load to installation surface

joining.method: final mesh/BRep union with positive overlap

requirements.load_or_flow: spread only local ornament handling load; primary service load stays in CORE

joining.method: replaceable keyed insertion with optional removable adhesive

requirements.load_or_flow: retention and handling only; no primary structural load
primary mounting load according to project-specific verification

keepouts.purpose: planning proxy for the product's primary functional volume; replace with exact CAD body
planning proxy for mounting tool and fastener insertion path

validation.method: run plan_hybrid_design.py and review requirement/component/interface matrices
validation.acceptance: no unresolved IDs, one owner per interface, every organic component has an interface and generation brief

validation.method: assemble proxy bodies and exact keep-outs in the project frame
validation.acceptance: no unintended collisions; assembly and removal paths remain open

validation.method: mesh intake report plus matched clay renders
validation.acceptance: identity, bounds, topology, negative spaces, and seam reserve pass component acceptance

validation.method: sections, wall/ligament measurement, interface geometry and surface-distance reports
validation.acceptance: all interface requirements pass and changes remain inside declared edit bands

validation.method: slice exact bodies with named profile and inspect seam/material boundaries
validation.acceptance: expected bodies/toolpaths, no trapped support, bed fit, and no thin-feature loss

validation.method: fit coupon, representative subassembly, then full prototype
validation.acceptance: chosen allowance and joining method meet the project-specific functional test
